title: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(1)
desc: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(1)

paragraphs.en: You can kill almost anything if you're willing to pay.
paragraphs.zh: 只要你愿意出钱，几乎可以猎杀任何动物。

paragraphs.en: Big or small. Land, water or air. Ten a penny or one of the last of its kind.
paragraphs.zh: 无论体型大小。陆生、水生或是飞禽。随处可见的普通物种，或是濒临灭绝的珍稀个体。

paragraphs.en: There's nearly always a way, though it might not make you popular.
paragraphs.zh: 办法几乎总能找到，只不过此举可能会让你饱受非议。

paragraphs.en: The Niassa special reserve, a vast reservation larger than Switzerland, stretches for 190 miles along the northern rim of Mozambique, taking in 4.2m hectares of woodland and rivers.
paragraphs.zh: 尼亚萨特别保护区是一片面积比瑞士还要辽阔的大型保护区，沿着莫桑比克北部边境绵延190英里，占地420万公顷，遍布林地与河流。

paragraphs.en: The reserve, one of the world's largest protected areas, is home to elephants, leopards, hyenas, zebras and about 1,000 wild lions.
paragraphs.zh: 这片保护区是全球最大的保护地之一，栖息着大象、豹子、鬣狗、斑马以及大约1000头野生狮子。

paragraphs.en: That word, however: protected. It applies to some, but not all, of its animal inhabitants.
paragraphs.zh: 然而“受保护”这个词。只适用于这里一部分动物，而非全部。

paragraphs.en: Each year, a specific number are set aside for sacrifice, for the greater good.
paragraphs.zh: 每年都会划定一定数量的动物作为牺牲品，以求换取更大层面的利益。

paragraphs.en: Not long ago, I joined an expedition in Niassa, with one of Africa's top game-hunting companies.
paragraphs.zh: 不久前，我跟随非洲一家顶尖狩猎公司，在尼亚萨保护区开启了一次远征。

paragraphs.en: Safari guide Paul Stones and his client, an American neurosurgeon in his early 70s, were preparing to shoot a cape buffalo with the expert assistance of two professional trackers: Mozambicans Sabite Mohamed and Tino Salvador.
paragraphs.zh: 游猎向导保罗·斯通斯和他的客户，一位年逾七旬的美国神经外科医生，正准备猎杀一头非洲水牛，两名莫桑比克专业追踪者萨比特·穆罕默德与蒂诺·萨尔瓦多为他们提供协助。

paragraphs.en: It took the trackers mere moments to find the first prints.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪者片刻之间就找到了第一处脚印。

paragraphs.en: The trail led us through the labyrinth of green and bronze.
paragraphs.zh: 足迹带着我们穿行在青绿色与古铜色交织的迷宫之中。

paragraphs.en: We passed along dusty, thorn-tangled riverbeds, then damper, cooler corridors of leaves set buzzing by tiny insects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着尘土飞扬、荆棘丛生的河床前行，随后走入更加湿润阴凉、枝叶繁茂的林间通道，无数小虫在林间嗡嗡作响。

paragraphs.en: The whole time we moved in silence.
paragraphs.zh: 一路上我们全程保持静默。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, there was a movement in the tall golden grasses close at hand something large, moving fast.
paragraphs.zh: 忽然，身旁高高的金色草丛里有动静，一个庞大的物体飞速掠过。

paragraphs.en: Stones and his client swung their guns sharply towards the source of the noise.
paragraphs.zh: 斯通斯和他的客户迅速将枪口转向声响传来的方向。

paragraphs.en: The trackers melted into the trees.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪者迅速隐入树丛。

paragraphs.en: A waterbuck burst from the grass, flinging vegetation aside like a curtain.
paragraphs.zh: 一头水羚猛地冲出草丛，拨开植被如同掀开幕布一般。

paragraphs.en: It leapt, balletic, into the air, before departing stage left at a flat gallop.
paragraphs.zh: 它轻盈一跃，姿态优雅，随即向着左侧全速飞奔而去，消失不见。

paragraphs.en: In the stunned pause afterwards I gulped with silent laughter, more from release of tension than comic effect.
paragraphs.zh: 短暂的错愕过后，我强忍着不出声地笑了起来，更多是紧张情绪得到释放，而非觉得这件事好笑。

paragraphs.en: We walked on.
paragraphs.zh: 我们继续向前行进。

paragraphs.en: Every year, clients of the trophy-hunting industry claim the lives of tens of thousands of wild animals across the world.
paragraphs.zh: 每年，战利品狩猎行业的客户都会夺去世界各地数万只野生动物的生命。

paragraphs.en: In sub-Saharan Africa, where hunting interests control vast swathes of the wildest land, trophy hunters often directly subsidise conservation projects on the grandest scale.
paragraphs.zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，狩猎权益掌控着大片原始荒野土地，战利品猎人往往会直接为规模宏大的野生动物保护项目提供资金补贴。

paragraphs.en: In 2014, the Texas oil heir Corey Knowlton is reported to have paid $350,000 for the pleasure of killing a critically endangered black rhino in Namibia.
paragraphs.zh: 据报道，2014年，得克萨斯州石油继承人科里·诺尔顿花费35万美元，获得了在纳米比亚猎杀一头极度濒危黑犀牛的资格。

paragraphs.en: He made the winning bid at an auction aimed at raising funds for African conservation run by the Dallas Safari Club.
paragraphs.zh: 他在达拉斯游猎俱乐部举办的、旨在为非洲野生动物保护筹款的拍卖会上出价中标。

paragraphs.en: Afterwards, Knowlton told the media that he had received death threats but that he made his kill with a clear conscience: "I felt like from day one it was benefiting the black rhino."
paragraphs.zh: 事后，诺尔顿向媒体表示自己收到过死亡威胁，但他心安理得地完成了猎杀：“从第一天起我就认为，这件事有益于黑犀牛种群。”

paragraphs.en: Conservation efforts, he said, were expensive; it took money to keep them alive.
paragraphs.zh: 他称野生动物保护耗资巨大，维持它们的生存需要资金。

paragraphs.en: "I'm absolutely hell-bent on protecting this animal."
paragraphs.zh: “我一心想要保护这一物种。”

paragraphs.en: He said less about what motivated him to kill one.
paragraphs.zh: 至于驱使他亲手猎杀一头犀牛的动机，他却甚少提及。

paragraphs.en: Professional hunters and trackers die too, in the pursuit of dangerous animals every year.
paragraphs.zh: 每年，专业猎手和追踪者在追捕危险野生动物的过程中也会付出生命的代价。

paragraphs.en: Stones and his client voice reverence for what they call "fair chase": an ethical distinction observed in certain sporting circles in which the quarry is felt to have a sporting chance of survival.
paragraphs.zh: 斯通斯和他的客户十分推崇他们口中的“公平追逐”原则：这是狩猎圈内遵循的一条道德准则，即猎物应当拥有一线逃生的机会。

paragraphs.en: Wild animals, moving freely through their natural habitat, are the platonic ideal.
paragraphs.zh: 野生动物能够在原生栖息地自由活动，就是这一理念最理想的状态。

paragraphs.en: At the other end of the spectrum is the "canned hunting" industry in which animals, particularly lions, are bred for the kill, and held captive in fenced enclosures.
paragraphs.zh: 与之截然相反的便是“圈养狩猎”产业，人们专门繁育狮子等动物以供猎杀，将它们圈养在围栏之内。

paragraphs.en: From this point of view, the larger and wilder the enclosure, and the freer the movement of the animal, the better.
paragraphs.zh: 按照这种评判标准，围栏的范围越大、环境越原始，动物的活动越自由，狩猎行为就越合乎标准。

paragraphs.en: And Niassa is one of the very biggest and wildest game reserves in the world.
paragraphs.zh: 而尼亚萨保护区正是全球规模最大、野性保留最为完好的猎物保护区之一。

paragraphs.en: Day after day, for 10 days, Stones and his client rose before dawn, dressed themselves in clothes of a drab dry-leaf green and set out on the trail.
paragraphs.zh: 一连十天，斯通斯和他的客户每天黎明前便起身，换上暗枯叶绿色的衣服，踏上追踪之路。

paragraphs.en: By the time the sun was high in the sky and the gunmen were soaked in sweat, there arose – in their minds, at least – a sense of parity, of worthy opposition, equal opportunity in this game of life and death, even if only one party has chosen to play.
paragraphs.zh: 等到烈日高悬，持枪的二人早已汗流浃背，至少在他们心中，一种对等之感油然而生——一场势均力敌的较量，一场生死博弈里机会均等，哪怕这场游戏，只有一方主动选择入局。
